faq_heading: West Newton condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in West Newton. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

West Newton, Surrey: 130 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 8 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 6%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 5 of 15 Surrey communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in West Newton rose from 121 in June to 130 in September (+7.4%), and 33 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 8.5% of Surrey’s 1,523 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in West Newton?
West Newton also had 83 houses listed and 17 sold in September, against 130 condos and townhomes listed. The West Newton houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in West Newton?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 130 condos and townhomes listed in West Newton. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is West Newton a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in West Newton had a sales ratio of 6%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in West Newton from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 33 condos and townhomes sold in West Newton over those 4 months, out of 591 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
